text:
Leah: FYI launching cohort 5 of the BakerPilot tomorrow — need a quick sync on enrollments + enablement materials. Main asks: confirm 15 seats, one onboarding workshop, feedback survey cadence. Who can cover outreach and first-week check-ins?

Jamal: I can own outreach and the first-week check-ins. I'll DM seat list in a bit. Need the workshop slides updated — @Priya can you confirm?

Priya: On it. I'll push a shortened deck by EOD, and drop notes for product team highlights. Any renewals flagged for this cohort?

Ethan: Two accounts (HarborHealth, LumenArc) show renewal risk score > 0.6 from QBR signals. Recommend we prioritize 1:1 with them during week 2, capture friction points in the survey. @Leah can you add them to the advocacy sequence?

Leah: Added both to advocacy track. Jamal, can you do HarborHealth? I'll take LumenArc.

Jamal: HarborHealth OK. Also flagging integrations questions — they asked for a sample config snippet. Copy of snippet:

```
api_key: REDACTED
model_pin: rwd-4.1
batching:
  max_tokens: 1024
```

Priya: Great. For feedback loop, propose survey on day 3 and day 14. Short NPS + 3 forced-choice problems + optional free text. Draft link: https://forms.gle/abcd1234 (will swap to internal later)

Ethan: +1 on day3/day14 cadence. Also suggest a short async eval run on week 2 — 20 prompt set to catch regressions. Product can run.

Leah: Who will do the workshop? Need someone for Q&A re: dedicated vs hosted options.

Priya: I can do workshop; prefer Wed 10am PT. Slide deck will include dedicated vs hosted decision tree.

Jamal: I'll send invites. Also proposing we add a quick CS Ops playbook: outreach template, troubleshooting checklist, escalation matrix. I'll draft and post here by tomorrow.

Leah: perfect. One more thing — let's log blockers in the pilot backlog: missing demo creds for HarborHealth, LumenArc legal review pending. @LegalBot can we get an update?

LegalBot: HarborHealth NDA received; LumenArc outstanding — assigned to @Marta.

Marta: Reviewing now, aiming to complete by EOD tomorrow.

Leah: Thanks. Action items recap:

- Jamal: outreach + HW check-ins + draft ops playbook
- Priya: slides + survey docs
- Leah: advocacy sequences + coordinate 1:1s
- Ethan: run async eval and escalate model findings
- Marta: legal review

Leah: I'll follow up with a single calendar invite and the onboarding checklist. :thumbsup:

Priya: Thanks team :sparkles:
